title: [Peek] Folder enumeration reported as FileNotSupported in telemetry
author: daverayment
summary: The folder-telemetry false positive is already handled in the same linked Peek previewer-reuse PR that closes the issue.

judgment.rationale: The issue is assigned and directly linked to PR #49963, whose change list includes UnsupportedFilePreviewer and PreviewerFactory edits matching the reported telemetry path.
evidence: The report precisely identifies FolderItem falling through to UnsupportedFilePreviewer and incorrectly logging ErrorEvent.FailureType.FileNotSupported.
The issue is assigned to daverayment.
PR #49963 closes #50016 and changes PreviewerFactory plus UnsupportedFilePreviewer-related files.
The linked PR body says UnsupportedFilePreviewer now supports reuse and refactors previewer creation/compatibility logic.
judgment.recommended_action: Track PR #49963 for resolution and avoid duplicating an already-owned Peek telemetry fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: The open linked Peek PR already changes the exact previewer-selection path named in the issue.

issue_context.summary: Peek logs FileNotSupported telemetry for folders because the unsupported preview path is reached for a non-file item, but the assigned maintainer already linked a fix PR.
known_information: The report includes an exact two-step repro and names the erroneous telemetry event.
The issue is assigned to daverayment.
The PR changes PreviewerFactory and UnsupportedFilePreviewer-related files.
inferences: This is a small but real telemetry correctness bug in Peek’s previewer-selection path.
Because the same PR also addresses a related Peek flicker report, maintainers are intentionally fixing the shared previewer lifecycle together.
issue_context.analysis: The dashboard should surface the linked fix coverage instead of asking for new information or starting duplicate design work.
initial_investigation: Current main still logs FileNotSupported at PreviewerFactory.cs before creating UnsupportedFilePreviewer.
The linked PR is already changing that previewer-selection layer and is the right place to carry the telemetry fix.
